question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A collection of sticks
solution:
The correct answer **Bundle.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** ****A bundle of sticks** means when you **put many sticks together.**
 
• A bundle of a stick is also an example of a **collective noun.​**
